question: When was AKGEC established|AKGEC kab bana|college kab shuru hua|college ki sthapna kab hui
answer: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College was established in 1998.
answer_hi: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College ki sthapna 1998 mein hui thi.

question: Which courses does AKGEC offer|what programs are available|kaun kaun se courses hain|B.Tech M.Tech MCA available hai kya
answer: The college offers a four-year B.Tech in all major engineering branches, a two-year M.Tech in four branches, and a two-year MCA.
answer_hi: College mein sabhi major engineering branches mein chaar saal ka B.Tech, chaar branches mein do saal ka M.Tech, aur do saal ka MCA hota hai.

question: Which M.Tech branches are offered|M.Tech mein kaun si branches hain|M.Tech specialisations
answer: M.Tech is offered in electronics and communication engineering, computer science, electrical and electronics engineering, and mechanical engineering.
answer_hi: M.Tech electronics and communication engineering, computer science, electrical and electronics engineering, aur mechanical engineering mein hota hai.

question: Is the campus wifi enabled|campus mein wifi hai kya|how many computers does the college have|college mein kitne computers hain
answer: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and the college has over 1400 computers networked through broadband.
answer_hi: Campus Wi-Fi se juda hai aur college mein 1400 se zyada computers broadband se networked hain.

question: How many books are in the central library|library mein kitni books hain|is the library automated
answer: The central library is fully automated and has over 1,00,000 books, plus national and international journals, e-journals and multimedia resources.
answer_hi: Central library poori tarah automated hai aur usmein 1,00,000 se zyada books, journals, e-journals aur multimedia resources hain.

question: Who can use the library|library membership kaise milti hai|can students use the central library|library kaun use kar sakta hai
answer: All students, faculty and staff of the college can use the library facilities after taking library membership.
answer_hi: College ke sabhi students, faculty aur staff library membership lekar library ki suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

question: How do I enter the library|library mein entry kaise hoti hai|do I need an ID card for the library
answer: Entry to the central library is through the library-cum-identity card, which is scanned at the entrance.
answer_hi: Central library mein entry library-cum-identity card se hoti hai, jo entrance par scan hota hai.

question: Does the library have e-resources|digital library kya hai|DELNET membership|online journals available hai kya
answer: The library has membership of DELNET and the National Digital Library, and offers an e-resources database.
answer_hi: Library ke paas DELNET aur National Digital Library ki membership hai, aur e-resources database bhi hai.

question: Is there a question paper bank in the library|previous year question papers library mein milte hain kya|model solutions
answer: The central library maintains a bank of question papers and model solutions.
answer_hi: Central library mein question papers aur model solutions ka bank rakha jata hai.
source_ref: https://www.akgec.ac.in/central-library/ (dataset chunk 5; the sentence is cut off in the dataset)

question: Do hostels and departments have libraries|hostel library hai kya|department library
answer: Departmental and hostel libraries are run by the respective departments and hostels, with resources on loan from the central library.
answer_hi: Departmental aur hostel libraries sambandhit departments aur hostels chalate hain, aur unke resources central library se loan par aate hain.

question: How many hostels are there|kitne hostel hain|how many students can stay in hostel|hostel mein kitne students reh sakte hain
answer: The college has three boys' hostels and three girls' hostels, accommodating over 1500 students.
answer_hi: College mein teen boys hostel aur teen girls hostel hain, jinmein 1500 se zyada students reh sakte hain.

question: Is hot water available in the hostel|hostel mein garam pani milta hai kya|solar water heater
answer: Solar water heaters provide hot water in all 6 hostels of the college.
answer_hi: College ke sabhi 6 hostels mein garam pani ke liye solar water heaters lage hain.

question: How can new students pay the fee|fees kaise bharni hai|fee payment mode|DD ya online transfer se fees
answer: New students can pay by demand draft in favour of Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College payable at Ghaziabad or Delhi, or by NEFT or RTGS online transfer.
answer_hi: Naye students demand draft se, jo Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College ke naam par Ghaziabad ya Delhi mein payable ho, ya NEFT ya RTGS online transfer se fees de sakte hain.
source: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question: What should I write on the demand draft|DD ke peeche kya likhna hai|can I submit the DD by post
answer: Write your name and mobile number on the back of the draft; it can be submitted by post or in person.
answer_hi: Draft ke peeche apna naam aur mobile number likhein; use post se ya khud aakar jama kar sakte hain.
source: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question: Is the counselling amount adjusted in the fees|counselling mein jo paisa diya wo fees mein adjust hoga kya|counselling deposit
answer: The amount deposited during counselling is deducted from the total fee.
answer_hi: Counselling ke dauran jama ki gayi raashi total fees mein se ghata di jati hai.
source: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question: Can the fee structure change|fees badal sakti hai kya|is the fee fixed
answer: The fee structure is subject to change by the state government's fee fixation committee.
answer_hi: Fee structure rajya sarkar ki fee fixation committee dwara badla ja sakta hai.
source: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question: What does the medical charge cover|medical charges mein kya milta hai|is there medical insurance
answer: Medical charges include hospitalisation insurance up to Rs 50,000, accident insurance up to Rs 1,00,000, and a free annual OPD medical checkup at Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
answer_hi: Medical charges mein 50,000 rupaye tak ka hospitalisation insurance, 1,00,000 rupaye tak ka accident insurance, aur Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital mein free annual OPD medical checkup shamil hai.
source: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question: Do I pay the exam fee to the college|exam fee kisko deni hai|university fee kaun lega
answer: The examination fee and the digital library fee are paid directly to the university when it asks for them, and the university may change them.
answer_hi: Examination fee aur digital library fee seedhe university ko tab dein jab woh maange; university inhe badal sakti hai.
source: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question: Is caution money refundable|caution money wapas milta hai kya|caution money kitni hai
answer: Caution money of Rs 5000 is part of the fee and is refundable.
answer_hi: 5000 rupaye ki caution money fees ka hissa hai aur refundable hai.
source: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question: How are admissions done|UPTAC counselling se admission hota hai kya|admission process kya hai
answer: Admission is through UPTAC counselling, and the amount deposited during counselling is deducted from the total fee.
answer_hi: Admission UPTAC counselling ke through hota hai, aur counselling mein jama ki gayi raashi total fees mein se ghata di jati hai.
source: AKGEC website: admission through UPTAC counselling page
source_ref: https://www.akgec.ac.in/admission-through-uptac-counselling-2025-26/ (dataset chunk 100: only the page title is in the dataset) and fee page chunk 72

question: Who is the director of AKGEC|director kaun hain|college ke director ka naam kya hai
answer: Dr. Hemant Ahuja is the Director of AKGEC, and Dr. R.K. Agarwal is the Director General.
answer_hi: Dr. Hemant Ahuja AKGEC ke Director hain, aur Dr. R.K. Agarwal Director General hain.
source: AKGEC website: director page and society event pages
